{{Quote|I am one of the Elders, yes. And I am asking you to remove your carriages, Not-for-You-to-Know. They frighten our people.''"<br />"''Then your people are wise.|[[Races-the-Water-Bringing-Wind]] and [[Belok Rhal]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>}}
The '''QuickStryke assault sled''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicle used by the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] in [[44 ABY]]. Several QuickStrykes were deployed during the [[siege of the New Jedi Temple]], and they were used again by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] to help put down the [[Octusi]] [[Blaudu Sextus revolt|revolt]] on [[Blaudu Sextus]].
